response.sql:
WITH patient_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic,
        AVG(HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
all_patient_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM patient_stats
    WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    AVG(ps.avg_pic) AS avg_of_patient_avg_pic,
    AVG(ps.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
    AVG(ps.ratio - apa.avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_ratio
FROM patient_stats AS ps
CROSS JOIN all_patient_average AS apa
WHERE ps.ratio > apa.avg_ratio;

assumptions.assumption: The all-patient average uses patients whose ratio is defined; patients with no HGB average or a zero HCT average have no defined ratio and are excluded. AVG ignores missing PIC values when computing the summary PIC average.
